etymology: a primitive root [compare 01911] used only as denominative from 03027
avSummary: praise 53, give thanks 32, confess 16, thank 5, make confession 2, thanksgiving 2, cast 1, cast out 1, shoot 1, thankful 1
definition:
1) to throw, shoot, cast
    1a) (Qal) to shoot (arrows)
    1b) (Piel) to cast, cast down, throw down
    1c) (Hiphil)
        1c1) to give thanks,, laud, praise
        1c2) to confess, confess (the name of God)
    1d) (Hithpael)
       1d1) to confess (sin)
       1d2) to give thanks
